text.p: These are the leading stories in the Tunisian press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- President Ben Ali congratulates newly elected Liberian President Taylor.

- Private investment in telecommunications sector expected to rise to 366 million dinars (about $336 million) over 1997-2001 period. Total private investment estimated at 43.6 million dinars in past years.
- Phosphate sales by Compagnie des Phosphates de Gafsa (CPG) rose 6.6 percent in first quarter to 1.77 million tonnes compared with same period in 1996.
